title: melos.yaml
description: The workspace configuration file for Melos

name.description: The name of the Melos workspace - used by IDE documentation.

anyOf.description: The hosted git repository which contains the workspace.
The self-hosted git repository which contains the workspace.

origin.description: The origin of the repository, e.g. https://git.example.dev/gitlab

packages.description: Patterns for packages that are included in the melos workspace.

ignore.description: Patterns for packages to exclude from the melos workspace.

sdkPath.description: Path to the Dart/Flutter SDK that should be used.

useRootAsPackage.description: Whether to include the repository root as a package in the workspace. Defaults to false.

discoverNestedWorkspaces.description: Whether to recursively discover packages in nested workspaces. Defaults to false.

pub.description: Configuration for HTTP requests to pub or alternate registries.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds applied to registry HTTP requests. Use 0 or omit to disable timeouts (default).

retry.description: Retry/backoff settings applied to registry HTTP requests.

delayFactorMillis.description: Base delay in milliseconds before exponential backoff is applied. Defaults to 200ms.

randomizationFactor.description: Jitter factor between 0 and 1 applied to each retry delay. Defaults to 0.25 (25%).

maxDelaySeconds.description: Maximum delay in seconds between retry attempts. Defaults to 30 seconds.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum number of attempts (including the first request) before giving up. Defaults to 8.

ide.description:
IDE-specific configurations.

This allows connecting the different scripts to the IDE or tells melos to generate the necessary files for mono-repositories to work in the IDE.

moduleNamePrefix.description:
Used when generating IntelliJ project modules files, this value specifies a string to prepend to a package's IntelliJ module name.

The default is 'melos_'.

scriptNamePrefix.description:
The text prepended to generated IntelliJ run configuration names for Melos scripts.

The default is 'Melos Run -> '. Set this to an empty string to omit the prefix.

command.description:
Command-specific configurations.

This allows customizing the default behavior of melos commands.

runPubGetInParallel.description: Whether to run `pub get` in parallel during bootstrapping.

runPubGetOffline.description: Whether to attempt to run `pub get` in offline mode during bootstrapping.

enforceLockfile.description:
Whether `pubspec.lock` is enforced when running `pub get` or not.
Useful when you want to ensure the same versions of dependencies are used across different environments/machines.

Defaults to false.

noExample.description:
Whether `pub get` is run with `--no-example`, so the example directory of a package is not resolved.

Defaults to false.

noPub.description:
Whether to skip running `pub get`. Shared dependencies, dependency overrides and IDE files are still applied.

Defaults to false.

pubGetArgs.description: Additional arguments to pass to `pub get` during bootstrapping.

hooks.description: Hooks to run at certain points of the command lifecycle.

dependencyOverridePaths.description: A list of paths to local packages relative to the workspace directory that should be added to each workspace package's dependency overrides. Each entry can be a specific path or a glob pattern.

dependencyOverrides.description: Dependencies that should be added to each workspace package's dependency overrides.

environment.description: Environment configuration to be synced between all packages.

dependencies.description: Dependencies to be synced between all packages.

dev_dependencies.description: Dev dependencies to be synced between all packages.

dryRun.description:
Whether packages are validated but not actually published.

Defaults to true.

gitTagVersion.description:
Whether to add any missing tags for the published release. Tags are only created when `dryRun` is disabled.

Defaults to false.

force.description:
Whether to skip the confirmation prompt when `dryRun` is disabled.

Defaults to false.

skipValidation.description:
Whether packages are published without validation and resolution, forwarded to `dart pub publish --skip-validation`.

Defaults to false.

pubServer.description: The URL of the package server to publish to. When not set, the per-package `publish_to` field is used.

hooks.description: Hooks to run at certain points of the command lifecycle.

updateChangelog.description:
Whether to update the CHANGELOG.md files of the versioned packages.

Defaults to true.

updateDependentsConstraints.description:
Whether to update the dependency version constraints of packages that depend on any of the packages that are versioned.

Defaults to true.

updateDependentsVersions.description:
Whether to make a new patch version and changelog entry in packages that are updated because of `updateDependentsConstraints`.

Defaults to true.

gitTagVersion.description:
Whether to tag the release.

Defaults to true.

gitCommitVersion.description:
Whether to commit the changes made to the pubspec.yaml and changelog files. Disabling this also disables `gitTagVersion`.

Defaults to true.

force.description:
Whether to skip the confirmation prompt.

Defaults to false.

versionPrivatePackages.description:
Whether to also version private packages, which are skipped by default.

Defaults to false.

preid.description: The prerelease identifier to use when versioning packages as a prerelease.

dependentPreid.description: The prerelease identifier to use for packages that are versioned because of a change in a dependency version. Falls back to `preid`.

message.description: A custom header for the generated CHANGELOG.md.

includeScopes.description: Whether to include conventional commit scopes in the generated CHANGELOG.md.

linkToCommits.description:
Whether to add links to commits in the generated CHANGELOG.md.

Disabled by default.

workspaceChangelog.description: Whether to additionally generate a summary CHANGELOG.md at the root of the workspace.

branch.description: If specified, prevents `melos version` from being used inside branches other than the one specified.

updateGitTagRefs.description: Whether to also update pubspec with git referenced packages.

releaseUrl.description:
Whether to generate and print a link to the prefilled release creation page for each package after versioning.

Disabled by default.

smartDependents.description:
Whether to only bump dependent versions and update constraints when declared SemVer constraints do not allow the updated version.

Disabled by default.

mode.description:
The mode in which packages in the workspace are versioned. In "fixed" mode (also known as lockstep versioning), every versioning run bumps all packages to the same new version, which is determined by the most significant change across the whole workspace.

Defaults to "independent".

workspaceTag.description:
Whether to tag releases with a single plain version tag for the whole workspace, e.g. "v1.2.3", instead of one tag per package, e.g. "package_name-v1.2.3". Only supported when "mode" is "fixed".

Defaults to false.

fetchTags.description:
Whether to fetch tags from the origin remote before versioning.

Defaults to true.

changelogFormat.description: Configure the format of the generated CHANGELOG.md.

includeDate.description:
Whether to include the date in the changelog entry in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format.

Disabled by default.

groupByType.description:
Whether to group changelog entries by their conventional commit type (e.g. all features under a "Features" header and all fixes under a "Bug Fixes" header).

Disabled by default.

hooks.description: Hooks to run at certain points of the command lifecycle.
Hooks to run at certain points of the command lifecycle.

concurrency.description:
The number of packages to analyze concurrently.

Defaults to 1.

fatalInfos.description:
Whether info level issues are treated as fatal errors.

Defaults to true.

fatalWarnings.description: Whether warnings are treated as fatal errors.

noPub.description:
Whether `--no-pub` is passed to `flutter analyze`, to skip the implicit pub get. Has no effect on `dart analyze`.

Defaults to false.

exec.description: The exec command configuration. Also used as the defaults for the exec options of scripts.

concurrency.description:
The number of packages to run the command in concurrently.

Defaults to the number of processors.

failFast.description:
Whether to stop executing the command in further packages as soon as it fails in one package.

Defaults to false.

orderDependents.description:
Whether to order the execution of the command based on the dependency graph of the packages.

Defaults to false.

groupLogs.description:
Whether the output of each package is buffered and printed grouped per package.

Defaults to false.

concurrency.description:
The number of packages to format concurrently.

Defaults to 1.

setExitIfChanged.description:
Whether to return exit code 1 if there are any formatting changes.

Defaults to false.

output.description:
Where `dart format` writes its output to.

Defaults to write.

lineLength.description: The line length to format the code to.

list.description: The list and changed command configuration.

long.description:
Whether to show extended information.

Defaults to false.

relativePaths.description:
Whether to print package paths relative to the root of the workspace.

Defaults to false.

format.description:
The output format.

Defaults to column.

noSelect.description:
Whether to skip the prompt that asks which package to run a script in, when the script defines packageFilters.

Defaults to false.

concurrency.description:
The number of packages to run tests in concurrently.

Defaults to 1.

noPub.description:
Whether `--no-pub` is passed to `flutter test`, to skip the implicit pub get. Has no effect on `dart test`.

Defaults to false.

scripts.description: A list of scripts that can be executed with `melos run` or will be executed before/after some specific melos commands.

name.description: A unique identifier for the script.

description.description: A short description, shown when using `melos run` with no argument.

anyOf.description: The command to execute in multiple packages.

concurrency.description: The number of packages to execute the command in concurrently.

failFast.description: Whether exec should fail fast and not execute the script in further packages if the script fails in a individual package.

orderDependents.description: Whether exec should order the execution of the script based on the dependency graph of the packages.

groupLogs.description: Whether the output of each package should be buffered and printed grouped per package once every package has finished, with failed packages printed last.

env.description: Environment variables that will be passed to the command to execute.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the environment variable.

packageFilters.description: If the command to execute is a melos command, allows filtering packages that will execute the command.

scope.description: Patterns for including packages by name.

ignore.description: Patterns for excluding packages by name.

dirExists.description: Include a package only if a given directory exists.

fileExists.description: Include a package only if a given file exists.

dependsOn.description: Include only packages that depend on a specific package.

noDependsOn.description: Include only packages that do not depend on a specific package.

diff.description: Filter packages based on whether there were changes between a commit and the current HEAD or within a range of commits. A range of commits can be specified using the git short hand syntax `<start-commit>..<end-commit>` and `<start-commit>...<end-commit>.

published.description: Include/Exclude packages that are up-to-date on pub.dev.

flutter.description: Include/Exclude packages that are Flutter packages.

name.description: A unique identifier for the script.

description.description: A short description, shown when using `melos run` with no argument.

steps.description: A list of commands to execute sequentially, enabling complex workflows.
